modmenu.descriptionTranslation.playfront: Your tunes, right on your screen. A lightweight, plug-and-play media overlay for Minecraft.
screen.playfront.config.polling_rate.too: How often the mod checks Windows for media updates. Lower values make the HUD react faster to song changes, but may increase CPU usage (highly negligible in modern systems).
screen.playfront.widget_positioning.info: Drag or use Arrow Keys to move. Press Confirm to save.
screen.playfront.config.title: Playfront Configuration
Click to open a screen where you can drag and move the widget.
screen.playfront.config.widget_scale.too: The size of the widget. Set to 0 to adapt to the GUI scale.
screen.playfront.config.widget_width.too: How wide the widget is. Make sure to account for the width of the cover art.
screen.playfront.config.show_cover_art.t: Whether to show the cover art. For music, it's the album art and for YouTube it's the thumbnail.
screen.playfront.config.background_varia: The visual style for the widget background.
screen.playfront.config.background_color:
The background color and opacity. 

§e(Note: Only works when using the COLOR background variant.)
screen.playfront.config.enable_border.to:
Toggles an inner border drawn inside the widget edges. 

§e(Note: Only works when using the COLOR background variant.)
screen.playfront.config.border_color.too:
Sets the inner border color and opacity. 

§e(Note: Only works when using the COLOR background variant.)
screen.playfront.config.title_color.tool: Sets the color of the title text.
screen.playfront.config.artist_color.too: Sets the color of the artist text.
screen.playfront.config.time_and_icon_co: Sets the color of the time & icon color.
screen.playfront.config.show_progress_ba: Toggles a progress bar showing the progress of the played media.
screen.playfront.config.progress_bar_act: Color for the elapsed progress bar.
screen.playfront.config.progress_bar_ina: Color for the unfilled background of the progress bar.
